Slabs: precast solid plank 5 cm + 5 cm topping (PL) in the classrooms, cast-in-place S0-S5 / RS1 / RS2 (S-11). Sections: beams S-13..S-16, footings S-07/S-08, slabs S-11, stair S-12, level sections S-10, trusses S-18/S-19. Schedules: column table S-09, windows น1-น3 (A-19), doors D0-D4 (A-20), AL1 (A-21), AL2/W1 (A-22). Notes: A-05..A-08 (architectural/general spec), S-07 piles, S-08 spread footings, S-19 roof steel — the set prints no concrete strength (except the plank topping '210/240' on S-04) and no fy; rebar grade is the boxed 'เหล็กเสริมข้ออ้อยทั้งหมด ให้ใช้ชั้นคุณภาพ SD 40' on every S-sheet; covers 4 cm columns / 9 cm underground pedestals.
